source: Virginia Department of Health, Office of Vital Records and Health Statistics (Health Statistics), City/County Health Profiles ('Health Profile, <locality>, <year>'), one page per locality and year, 1997-2013
note: Exact locality death counts as printed on the VDH City/County Health Profile pages (one page per locality and year, 1997-2013, read in Chrome from the public pages, no file download). No small-number suppression is stated or visible: zeros print as 0. Page layouts differ by year and were parsed by header; the sum of localities equals the state total from 2002 on. Causes: all deaths, malignant neoplasms, diseases of the heart, cerebrovascular diseases, chronic lower respiratory (chronic obstructive pulmonary diseases in 1997-98), unintentional injury (raw key 'accidents', not a map measure), influenza and pneumonia, diabetes, suicide, nephritis and nephrosis, Alzheimer's, chronic liver disease, and homicide (1997-2004 only; later profile pages drop the line). Geography: the profiles list 134 names; 'Bedford City' is added to 'Bedford Co.' because CDC and the site fold the former city into Bedford County (the two sum to CDC's all-deaths count within 1% every year); same-name city/county pairs (Fairfax, Franklin, Richmond, Roanoke) are mapped by FIPS in fips_alias. Quality screen against CDC all-deaths (CDC publishes every locality-year): localities whose VDH all-deaths count agrees with CDC in under 60% of years are left out entirely (Bristol, Fairfax City, Falls Church, Norton; their VDH counts do not match CDC's); 17 other locality-years that disagree with CDC all-deaths are left out for every cause (Alleghany 1997-2001, where CDC includes the former Clifton Forge city and the VDH list has no Clifton Forge page, plus single years elsewhere); one further county (Washington) is left out because its cause-specific counts agree with CDC in under 90% of checked cells (its all-deaths counts agree but its cause-specific counts do not); cancer 2008 is removed because the profile pages' locality values for that year are scrambled (they sum to the state total but do not match CDC). The profile pages do not say whether deaths are by residence or occurrence; the VDH annual report convention is residence and agreement with CDC (residence) supports that. No terms of use, citation or redistribution wording is printed on the pages; terms status none_stated. Counts only.
